name: Solo Run Fest 2026
short_description: Solo Run Fest 2026 is a half-marathon held on September 27, 2026 in Surakarta, Jawa Tengah, Indonesia, with 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distance options.
ai_summary: Solo Run Fest 2026 is a half-marathon event taking place on September 27, 2026 in Surakarta, Jawa Tengah, Indonesia. Runners can choose from three distances: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. Registration is currently open, with prices ranging from Rp 200,000 to Rp 650,000 depending on the category chosen.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km) to suit different runner levels
Wide price range allows flexibility depending on chosen distance
cons: Price range is fairly wide, so exact cost depends on category chosen

excerpt_quotes.quote: Seru banget. Banyak yang ikut. Acaranya seru. Rute flyover cukup menantang karena menanjak.
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Runner Nanda (Madiun), quoted in Jawa Tengah provincial government news report on Solo Run Fest 2025

excerpt_quotes.quote: Rutenya enak, ada jalan yang memiliki elevasi, ada yang datar. Harapannya ke depan untuk sterilisasi jalurnya saja agar lebih nyaman bagi pelari
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Runner Darwis (traveled from Yogyakarta), quoted in Tribun Solo advertorial coverage

excerpt_quotes.quote: Acara mantap, pesertanya banyak, refreshment juga lengkap. Flyover menantang karena menanjak.
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Amikom Solo students Nanda and Juni, quoted in Kebumen Update

research_highlights: Start at Stadion Manahan Solo, finish at Taman Balekambang; 2026 edition offers 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon categories (2025 had only 5K and 10K)
Early morning start times reported for the 2025 edition: 10K around 05:30 WIB and 5K around 05:50 WIB
Course includes a flyover (jalan layang) section that multiple runners described as challenging due to the incline, alongside flatter stretches
The 2025 edition drew about 6,000 participants including the Governor of Central Java; organizers are targeting 7,000 participants for 2026
Beyond the run itself, the event includes a UMKM (small business) bazaar, sportswear expo, and live music performances at the festival area
research_watchouts: A runner who traveled from Yogyakarta suggested organizers improve route sterilization (crowd/traffic control) to make the course more comfortable for participants
The flyover climb was repeatedly singled out by participants as the toughest part of the route due to its ascent
